'''Motivation''' was a section of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's]] [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] that dealt with members who failed to live up to tenets of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Motivations goal was to modify their behavior and turn them into citizens useful to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Motivation reported a staggering success rate, but the results were a five-fold exaggeration of the true figure. However, their reputation for ensuring that no troublemakers were released before had proven themselves to be useful to the New Order was well deserved.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
